label: Road accident mortality
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = ITF/IRTAD road-safety statistics via SDMX (OECD.ITF DSD_INDICATORS@DF_SAFETY), road fatalities per 100,000 population as submitted by the member countries' police crash registration systems (FATALITIES/10P5HB, TRANSPORT_MODE=ROAD, all vehicle types, annual rows only — the monthly/quarterly prints the same flow carries are pinned out at the URL), 55 areas, 1994-2025. Witness tier = the WHO Global status report on road safety via GHO (RS_198, modeled estimates, 197 countries at the single 2021 vintage — no multi-year series on the API, probed and recorded). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: as-reported registrations beside modeled estimates, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OECD.ITF = OECD/ITF Terms and Conditions, attribution required; GHO witness = CC-BY-3.0-IGO.
notes: THE TODD ARC PRINTS ITSELF (todd_refs: 4 citations, all Le Fou et le Prolétaire): France 1994 = 15.2 -> 2024 = 4.7 (the sécurité routière arc — the threefold fall of the machine-age mortality the 1979 table measured at its peak), Germany 1994 = 12.1 -> 2024 = 3.3, Sweden 1994 = 7.5-8 -> 2.0-2.1 — and the USA's own divergence: 1994 = 15.5 -> 2023 = 12.2, the rich world's one series that never fell by half (the Anglophone automobile-society contrast Todd's comparative tables live on). The POST-SOVIET CRISIS prints at the top of the slice: LVA 1994 = 28.4, the Estonian/ Latvian/Slovenian 1990s peaks — the transition's road-death epidemic, the mortality family's own Russia-adjacent story (RUS itself absent from the flow — see sources). THE WITNESS'S WORLD FACE: 197 countries at the 2021 vintage, RUS 10.6, FRA 4.7, the coverage coupe the GHE-cirrhosis pattern set. THE HONEST LIMITS: the 1974 table itself (13 countries, deaths per million vehicles, the WHO print Todd read) is BOOK data — territory curated, the same line the 19th-century French boards hold; the per-vehicle denominator lives one door away (10P4VEH_MOT_ROAD, registered non-wired); RUS absent from the whole canonical flow; the witness is a single-vintage cross-section, no trend on that tier; no sex dimension (the flow prints none — total road deaths, the registration's own shape).
